name: Colour Lab
description: Inspect one colour in OKLCH — a gamut chart showing exactly where sRGB, Display-P3 and Rec.2020 end at this hue, plus every notation, the nearest displayable colour, and readability against your brand surfaces.

inputs.label: Colour
inputs.help: The one colour this whole sheet is about — defaults to your brand primary.

inputs.label: Chart
inputs.help: Which plane through OKLCH space to slice. Lightness × Chroma is the working view.

inputs.label: Show up to
inputs.help: How far past sRGB to chart. Display-P3 is what most current screens and phones can show.

inputs.label: Read against
inputs.help: The background the readability scores are measured against.

inputs.label: Paired text
inputs.help: The text colour scored on top of the subject colour.

inputs.label: Show tone ramp
inputs.help: A perceptual light-to-dark ramp through the colour, with each step's gamut marked.
